div.head: Af 1.5
div.ab: Gif hine mon ófslea, licgge he orgilde.
Gif hine man ofslea, lecge orgylde.
Gif hine mon ófslea, licgge he orgilde.
Gif hine mon ófslea, licgge he orgilde.
Wenn man ihn [beim Zwange] tödtet, liege er unvergolten.
If he is killed [in the compelling], let him lie unpaid for.
If he is slain, no wergeld shall be paid for him.
If he is killed, he is to lie unpaid for.
If he is killed [while resisting], let him lie without wergild.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Alfred’s pledge-breaker, who ‘lies unpaid for’, may face the same fate. [n.] Cf. II Atr. 3:4 ... ungylde; V Atr. 31:1/VI Atr. 38 ... ægylde

note.seg: æ-, or-, ungilde hält für dem Norden entlehnt Steenstrup Danelag 357 [?]. ‘Man’ ist der Kläger; denn den Strafrichter vor Wergeldforderung der Sippe des Erschlagenen zu schützen war unnötig

Steenstrup Danelag 357 [?] holds æ-, or-, ungilde to be borrowed from the North. The ‘one’ is the plaintiff; for there was no need to protect the criminal judge against a wergild claim by the slain man’s kindred
